fixture: Comparator decision bench (issue #127): the whole modulator (clkgen + both integrator cells + the vendored comparator + the NAND SR latch and dp/dn/bs buffers), two variants on the DR-002 full grid -- `loop` with the spec reference pair and a 0.06 V DC input, `trip` with the reference pair nulled and a staircase input that walks integrator 2's output across the trip point
result_kind: simulated (ngspice, transistor-level netlists of design/modulator + design/ota/ota_fd + the vendored comparator; not the behavioural model). Not measured.

conditions.corner_set: DR-002 full grid, 5 process x 3 T x 3 Vdda
substitutions: trip variant only: VREFP = VREFN = VCM = 0.9 V, which opens the feedback loop without disconnecting anything -- every reference switch still operates, it just transfers no charge
the differential input is an ideal source pair at the block boundary (DR-005), as in every other bench here
nothing in the comparator's own surroundings is substituted: real phi1, real integrator-2 OTA outputs, real NAND SR latch, real dp/dn/bs buffers loaded by both integrators' reference muxes

pass_criterion: loop: tdec_frac <= 1 at every corner, i.e. the worst delay from the phi1 rise to dp/dn carrying the new decision fits inside the phi1 high time that corner actually delivers; plus n_flip >= 2 so a corner that never changed dp/dn cannot pass with no evidence. trip: flip_up and flip_dn found, k_up/k_dn strictly inside the staircase, and the sweep spans at least +/-3.5 mV, so the trip points are bracketed. Kickback is reported, never graded: this repo has no kickback limit of its own and none is invented here.

derived.limit_derivation: The limit is the phi1 high time measured at the same corner, not the 97.65625 ns bare half-period: clkgen spends part of each half on the non-overlap gaps, so the comparator is given slightly less (and, because the phi1 buffer chain is not symmetric, sometimes slightly more) than half a period. No reservation is subtracted for the reference node to settle inside phi1 after dp/dn change -- no committed record in this repo bounds that time -- so the limit is the bare delivered phi1 width and is labelled as such.

model_b_units.derivation: one model-B x2 unit is 1.2 V of differential output at integrator 2: the cell moves that output by 0.5*(v_o1_diff + vdac_diff) per clock with vdac_diff = -y*(VREFP - VREFN) = -y*1.2 V, model B moves x2 by 0.5*(x1 - y), and the two agree for 1 unit = 1.2 V. Same factor sim/integrator-ci/README.md derives for x1.
model_b_units.what_these_numbers_are: A staircase shows the comparator only grid points one step apart, so the offset is resolved to +/- step/2 and the measured v_trip_up - v_trip_dn is an UPPER BOUND on the hysteresis width, not a measurement of it -- a comparator with no hysteresis at all reads one whole step here. Each corner carries its own `quantization` block with that step and both hysteresis bounds; `comparator_hysteresis` below is the raw difference, i.e. the upper bound, and is the conservative value to give model B.

kickback.note: Peak deviation of each node from the value it holds through the same phi1, at the binding decision-time corner. This is the whole disturbance across the phi1 edge: the integrator's own phi2 -> phi1 switch transition (symmetric, so it shows up in the single-ended numbers and cancels in the differential ones) superposed on the comparator's kickback (driven by its input pair, so it scales with the differential). The two sampled clocks have different differentials, so the record carries the evidence for that split rather than asserting it. Reported as a number; NO pass limit is invented for it. The sibling's own ratified 5 mV row is against its bench -- ideal sources through 1 kOhm, a different open_pdks pin -- not this loading, so it is context and not a limit here.
